assets.description: Low pale elliptical colonnade with detached round columns, recessed dark glazing, layered fascia, entrance, raised roof and stone apron.
assets.uncertainty_notes: Plan radii and column count are visual estimates from the contact sheet; the rear ellipse is procedural and may be hidden by scene dressing. Door positions are inferred from the close approach view.

assets.description: Long gently curved academic background block made from repeated silver floor slabs, dark blue glass ribbons, mullions and roof trims.
assets.uncertainty_notes: The source imagery only exposes portions of the west building; curvature, floor spacing and depth are deliberately approximate and should be tuned by the scene compositor.

coordinate_contract.build_side_effects: Creates and returns asset roots only; does not clear scene, set camera/world, render, or export.
